captive_summary: No captive power - TotalEnergies' own project announcement states the FSRU's purpose was to pipe regasified LNG onward to power stations, explicitly naming the 127 MW Maria Gleta plant, not to power itself with an on-site plant. The project reached only a 2019 pre-FEED conceptual study before being abandoned in 2021; no FSRU vessel was ever selected, so onboard generation (per the FSRU-onboard convention) cannot be separately evaluated either.
confirmed_how: TotalEnergies' 24 July 2019 press release ('Total will develop the LNG market in Benin') states: 'offshore pipeline connexion to the existing and planned power plants in Maria Gleta' and 'The gas import project will supply plants in Benin, such as the new 127 MW power station at Maria Gleta, with imported liquefied natural gas' - a direction-test negative (gas flows OUT to an external plant, matching GEM's own gogpt_total_mw of 127.4 for the same plant). Sofregaz's own project page confirms the work performed was only a 2019 pre-FEED conceptual study (evaluating 'three potential FSRU connection schemes') before TotalEnergies abandoned the project in 2021 (per the independent LNG2030 tracker); no specific FSRU vessel was ever named.

verification_log.note: TotalEnergies own press release naming Maria Gleta as the supplied plant

gogpt_prior_assessment: The prior (Maria Gleta power station I, 127.4 MW, gogpt_captive=False) is exactly the plant this project was designed to supply via offshore pipeline - confirms a PowerPlantsSupplied relationship (now moot, project cancelled), not a captive-power question. Same TotalEnergies press release as above.
gogpt_candidate_basis: Not a gas power station at this site at all - the terminal's role was gas supply outward to Maria Gleta, not on-site generation.
status_or_other_findings: Project abandoned/cancelled circa 2021 after only a 2019 pre-FEED conceptual study (Sofregaz) - consistent with GEM's cancelled/inferred status.
notes: PowerPlantsSupplied direction-test case: intended to feed the Maria Gleta 127 MW power station via offshore pipeline - the OPPOSITE relationship to captive power (regas gas piped OUT). Flagged for awareness only; project is cancelled so the relationship is moot for a live edit.
